topic: How Fees and Expenses Affect Your Investment Portfolio
source_evidence: Does the product have more than one share class? If so, how do the fees compare across share classes? What is the overall lowest cost share class available and how do I qualify for that share class?
answer: When an investment offers multiple share classes, compare the fees and expenses for each class rather than assuming they cost the same. Ask which share class has the lowest overall cost and what qualifications apply. Also ask whether investing a particular amount makes you eligible for a discount. These comparisons can help you understand the costs associated with the share class available to you.
